remarks: Discover the perfect blend of space and convenience with this oversized one-bedroom condo, located in Stamford's sought-after Edgewater building. Ideally positioned in a prime mid-city location, you'll be just minutes from downtown restaurants, shopping, the train station, and major highways. Freshly painted and move-in ready, this bright second-floor unit offers an open layout with a spacious living and dining area, a large bedroom, a full bathroom, and generous closet space. Assigned parking spot #13 is included, with additional street parking available for guests. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are all covered by the HOA. Plus, one cat or dog is welcome! Laundry and storage are conveniently located on the main level. A fantastic opportunity for easy living in the heart of Stamford
